label: Plato, Republic 479a–e: Many beautiful things can appear ugly, just things unjust, doubles halves…
interpretation: Bounded source reading, retained as prose because this issue supplies no adequate formal semantics for the methodological or contextual content. Many beautiful things can appear ugly, just things unjust, doubles halves, and large things small. This contrast with a stable Form is not encoded as an unrestricted logical contradiction in the same respect.
